conclusion: Both p=3 and p=7 ranks are constant across all 28 Spence graphs. The 2-adic ladder is uniquely exceptional. The Z/7^15 Seidel invariant from Pass 96 has no adjacency shadow. The 2-rank ladder {17,8,2,1} is the sole source of non-trivial arithmetic variation.
theorem: Among all arithmetic invariants naturally suggested by the SRG(40,12,2,4) parameters, only the 2-adic adjacency arithmetic varies across the 28 Spence graphs. This is a closure theorem: the 2-adic ladder is uniquely exceptional.
